definition: Number of 4-owner subsets whose six unordered owner pairs are all present in the top-level simple relation support. Parallel edge multiplicity and endpoint/resource type are ignored.
nonclaims: No geometry, time, or physics claim.
No claim that K4 is uniquely minimal among all possible descriptors.
Validation on the discovery census is an integration/prediction check, not an independent holdout confirmation.

prediction_gate.scope: complete frozen n=7 connected unlabeled simple-graph census

scientific_role: Shadow descriptor for the collective topology/service observer only. It is evaluated beside, never inside, current promotion or maturation signatures.
